planets.name: TOI-3714 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-3714 with a 2.15-day year, found in 2022.

text.card: TOI-3714 b was found in 2022 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-3714. Its orbit and size follow Cañas et al. 2022's fit, the archive's default.
